Owen's favorite animal is the rabbit. Owen hopes to visit London one day. Owen learned a lot about science. My aunt works for a famous literary magazine.
Owen likes snowy days best. Owen and Kate had great fun there. They took many photos at the work station. Sprinkle a little paprika on the roasted potatoes.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the front desk by bike. The weather was snowy that day. Life is full of small surprises. Net pay is what actually lands.
Owen plays baseball with Kate every Saturday. Last Saturday, Owen and Kate went to the front desk. Both of them like salad and milk.
